summary: {person} holds back a resignation announcement until the budget vote is over.
realLife: Flint council president Allie Herkenroder delayed telling people she would resign because she wanted the budget vote to go ahead.
gates: A member planning to leave office still has a budget vote on the calendar.
weights: A close vote increases the importance of the effective date.
inGame: needs: the timing of a resignation against the council calendar.

turns.what: The member resigns before the budget vote.
turns.pulledBy: The council postpones the vote beyond the member's intended departure.
turns.writesBack: The roll lists the seat as vacant.

turns.what: The member announces the resignation now and sets a later effective date.
turns.pulledBy: Colleagues need time to arrange succession.
turns.writesBack: The notice preserves a final meeting date.
